text.en:
Using your Grenade or hitting an enemy with a Powered Melee Attack grants a stack of Well-Rounded. Super Ability grants two stacks.

+10 Range, +10 Stability, and +10 Handling per stack.
Maximum of 2 Stacks. Lasts 15 seconds.

< table formula background_2 > 
|  Stacks| Effective Range         | Ready Speed           | Stow Speed           <bold/>
|b 1x    | <formula [range_0] /> | <formula [ready_0] /> | <formula [stow_0] />
|b 2x    | <formula [range_1] /> | <formula [ready_1] /> | <formula [stow_1] />
<$>

enhanced (
#e Increased Stat Bonuses.
)
text.zh-chs:
投掷手雷或使用充能近战击中目标可获得 1 层全面发展增益，使用超能可获得 2 层增益。

每层增益 +10 射程，+10 稳定性，+10 操控性。
最高叠加 2 层，持续 15 秒。

< table formula background_2 > 
|  层数| 有效射程         | 拔枪速度           | 收枪速度           <bold/>
|b 1x    | <formula [range_0] /> | <formula [ready_0] /> | <formula [stow_0] />
|b 2x    | <formula [range_1] /> | <formula [ready_1] /> | <formula [stow_1] />
<$>

enhanced (
#e 增加属性提升量。
)
